description: Internal, persistence only (never part of the REST API): the fields of a Request or Renewal that have no column of their own in DATA_ACCESS_REQUEST, stored as its REQUEST_JSON document.

concreteType.description: The class name of the RequestInterface implementation, Request or Renewal, that the document is read back as.

accessRequirementVersionNumber.description: The version of the Access Requirement that the request was last saved against.

institution.description: The name of the institution where the collaborators work.

principalInvestigator.description: Information about the research project's principal investigator.

signingOfficial.description: Information about the institution's signing official.

accessorChanges.description: List of user changes, in the order the user entered them.

schemaData.description: Request data that was provided using the associated JSON Schema.

publication.description: Renewal only: link(s) to publication that used the controlled data.

summaryOfUse.description: Renewal only: summary of how the data has been used.
